messages:
Nora (CSM): Quick QBR check — 48h out. Need final slide owners and exec ask alignment for Solara Health. Renewal target FY26 Q2. Main risks: onboarding lag + intermittent SSO. Can owners confirm slides + 1 clear exec ask each?
Jamal: I can own onboarding health + adoption metrics. Will add slides to the shared deck. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Priya: I'll take the Exec ask slide and draft two ask options (roadmap priority vs commercial concession). Prefer we lock preferred ask by noon tomorrow.
Cal: I'll do tech blockers (SSO, data sync errors). Need the support ticket ID and any recent logs — @Nora can you drop them here?
Nora (CSM): Ticket ID is INC-7134. I pasted the short error snippet in the deck notes. Also FYI cohort B shows a 22% week-over-week dip — flagged in health dashboard.
qbr-bot: Reminder — QBR template v3 uploaded: https://drive.company/QBR-templates. Please follow structure: Customer Overview (1), Health (1), Asks (1), Plan & Risks (1).
Becky (AE): I'll prep the commercial + renewal slide with current commitment and churn risk notes. Question: do we want to propose a 6-month pilot extension as a formal option?
Priya: Yes, include as Option B (pilot + feature commitment). Option A = standard renewal. Keep both numbers visible.
Jamal: For onboarding metrics I’ll export week-by-week MAU, activation funnel, and time-to-first-success. Putting CSV in the deck assets.
Cal: Action for eng: triage SSO session timeout and token refresh errors. I will ping eng-oncall. Also saw a KV cache mismatch causing 500s; added a short note in the tech slide.
Nora (CSM): Slide checklist (please paste into your slide notes):
```
- Owner name
- 1-slide summary
- 1 key exec ask (preferably quantifiable)
- 2 supporting bullets (metrics/impact)
- 1 mitigation for top risk
```
Jamal: Added MAU chart and funnel to slide 3. Quick ask — do we want raw numbers or pct change for execs?
Becky (AE): Use pct change + 1 callout with raw ARR impact. Execs respond better to $$ impact.
Priya: I'll draft the exact ask language. Will post both ask options in thread so we can vote.
Nora (CSM): Dry run scheduled 10:00am tomorrow — please be ready to present your slide and speak to the single ask.
Cal: Will be on for the dry run. Tagging :thumbsup:.
Becky (AE): Putting slides into the deck now. I'll also add a single-line negotiation fallback and renewal cadence.
qbr-bot: Note — please name files: "Solara_QBR_<owner>.pptx" and sync by EOD.
Nora (CSM): Final ask: everyone add slide and confirm in thread when done. I’ll compile the final deck and circulate 2 hours before dry run. Thanks all! :handshake:
